chapter: New York, Dallas and Kansas City
title: Back in Dallas near the Adolphus, then a telegram from Harlan Leonard
summary: The band rehearsed near the Adolphus, heard white bands there, and then Moore was wired to join Harlan Leonard in Kansas City.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: Yeh. So shortly after that, did you stay with Purcell much longer than that, or did that gig break up?

No, no, we ended up back in Dallas, [Hotel] and they would practice across from Adolphus, and we kept late hours and across we used to hear, when traffic wasn't so enormous, hear bands across the street at Adolphus -- the CasaLoma --
And bands like Pee Wee Hunt, the great white bands. They all would invariably come over and listen to our band and our show.
Did you hear Harry James down there around that time?

Yeh, yeh, right, right, but mostly -- as I was saying we used to have all these musicians that come from famous bands playing at the Adolphus and they'd come and listen to us. Well, however, a little while later I received a telegram from Kansas City and Harlan Leonard needed a trombone player.
S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943
